thread:
sam: dropping a small comp — attach tiny inline actions to streaming replies: [Stop] [Regenerate] + a muted per-response token badge. Preview: https://figma.redwood/playground/inline-mini-v2

dana: Inline controls reduce context switching. Agree token badge should be per-response (muted) and cumulative in session sidebar.

leah: accessibility: buttons must have explicit aria-labels and visible focus. stream container should use aria-live="polite" and we should avoid announcing every token update (announce on chunk boundaries).

marc: runtime note: stop must cancel inflight and persist partial text; regenerate spawns a new response_id. Include response_id and stream_index in analytics.

a11y-bot: suggestion: events — playground.stream.stop, playground.stream.regen, playground.token.peek. Include props: response_id, token_estimate, user_prefers_reduced_motion.

dana: motion: follow prefers-reduced-motion; use opacity fades instead of shimmer. CSS snippet: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .shimmer{ animation:none } }

sam: keyboard map idea: Esc = stop (when actions focused), Shift+Esc = pause/resume render, Cmd/Ctrl+R = regenerate (requires action focus). Keep shortcuts scoped.

leah: prompt library placement debate: right rail vs slide-over. Right rail discoverable but may feel busy; slide-over less permanent. Proposal: rail collapsed by default, slide-over on small screens. Must support keyboard toggle and focus trap.

marc: Action items:
- Design: finalize inline sizes + token microcopy (sam)
- Dev: stop/regenerate semantics + analytics props (marc)
- A11y: aria-live strategy + keyboard focus (leah)
- Analytics: confirm event names and payload (a11y-bot)

sam: I'll file UI-PL-8607 and move comp to ready if no objections. :thumbsup:
